properties_with_code.text: set_storage must assert account exists in main trie before modifying storage.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall set_storage(s, addr, key, val): trie_get(s._main_trie, addr) is not None

properties_with_code.text: Empty storage trie must be deleted from _storage_tries after set_storage clears all keys.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall set_storage(s, addr, k, v): trie._data == {} => addr not in s._storage_tries

locations.note: Handles storage trie cleanup and deletion

properties_with_code.text: destroy_account must remove both account from main trie and its storage trie.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall destroy_account(s, addr): trie_get(s._main_trie, addr)==None AND addr not in s._storage_tries

locations.note: EIP-6780 variant with same-transaction creation check

properties_with_code.text: state_root must not be computed while snapshots are active (during a transaction).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall state_root(s): len(s._snapshots) == 0

properties_with_code.text: state_root must incorporate all storage roots into the main trie root computation.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall state_root(s): root(s._main_trie, get_storage_root) includes root(s._storage_tries[addr]) for all addr

locations.note: Computes storage root for individual account

properties_with_code.text: get_account must never return None; must return EMPTY_ACCOUNT for non-existent addresses.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall get_account(s, addr): result is not None; not isinstance(trie_get, Account) => result == EMPTY_ACCOUNT

locations.note: Returns nil for non-existent accounts; callers handle nil as empty
Example caller that returns zero for nil account

properties_with_code.text: get_storage must return U256(0) for addresses without a storage trie.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall get_storage(s, addr, key): addr not in s._storage_tries => result == U256(0)

properties_with_code.text: get_storage_original must return U256(0) for addresses in created_accounts set.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall get_storage_original(s, addr, key): addr in s.created_accounts => result == U256(0)

properties_with_code.text: get_storage_original must read from outermost (first) snapshot, not current state.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall get_storage_original(s, addr, key): source == s._snapshots[0] (not s._main_trie or s._snapshots[-1])

locations.note: Reads from originStorage map which captures pre-transaction state

properties_with_code.text: Nonce must increase by exactly 1 per increment_nonce call; no skip or overflow.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall increment_nonce(s, addr): nonce_post == nonce_pre + Uint(1)

properties_with_code.text: Transient storage must be cleared between transactions (scoped to single transaction).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall tx boundary: transient_storage._tries == {} at transaction start

locations.note: Resets transient storage map at transaction boundary

properties_with_code.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all transaction data from P2P must be fully validated before state access.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall p2p_msg(peer, tx_bytes): decode_transaction(tx_bytes) AND validate_transaction(tx) before any state mutation

properties_with_code.text: Engine API (EL-CL boundary) is JWT-authenticated; unauthenticated callers must be rejected.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall engine_api_call(caller, req): caller.jwt_valid == true; else reject

locations.note: JWT authentication middleware for Engine API

properties_with_code.text: State modifications only occur within a begin/commit or begin/rollback bracket.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall state_mutation(s): len(s._snapshots) > 0

properties_with_code.text: After set_account_balance, the account balance must equal the exact amount specified.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall set_account_balance(s, addr, amt): get_account(s, addr).balance == amt

properties_with_code.text: After set_code, if code is empty and nonce==0 and balance==0, account must be destroyed.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall set_code(s, addr, b''): nonce==0 AND balance==0 => destroy_account(s, addr)

properties_with_code.text: storage_root must return EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT for addresses without a storage trie.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall storage_root(s, addr): addr not in s._storage_tries => result == EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT

properties_with_code.text: storage_root must not be computed while snapshots are active.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall storage_root(s, addr): len(s._snapshots) == 0

properties_with_code.text: mark_account_created marker must persist across inner rollbacks until outermost commit/rollback.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall mark_created(s, addr) then inner_rollback: addr in s.created_accounts until outermost pop clears set

properties_with_code.text: Transaction validation must enforce gas >= max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor) per EIP-7623.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.gas >= max(intrinsic_gas(tx), calldata_floor(tx))

properties_with_code.text: Transaction gas must not exceed TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT (16,777,216) per EIP-7825.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.gas <= 16777216

properties_with_code.text: Transaction nonce must be less than U64.MAX_VALUE per EIP-2681.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): U256(tx.nonce) < U256(U64.MAX_VALUE)

properties_with_code.text: Contract creation initcode must not exceed MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.to == Bytes0 => len(tx.data) <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE

properties_with_code.text: ECDSA signature r must be in range (0, SECP256K1N) for sender recovery.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): 0 < tx.r < SECP256K1N

properties_with_code.text: ECDSA signature s must enforce low-s: 0 < s <= SECP256K1N/2.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): 0 < tx.s <= SECP256K1N / 2

locations.note: Half curve order for low-s check

properties_with_code.text: decode_transaction must reject unknown transaction type prefixes with TransactionTypeError.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall decode_tx(bytes): bytes[0] not in {1,2,3,4} AND not LegacyTx => raise TransactionTypeError

properties_with_code.text: encode_transaction and decode_transaction must be inverses for all valid transaction types.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall valid tx: decode_transaction(encode_transaction(tx)) == tx

properties_with_code.text: Each transaction type must use its own unique signing hash function bound to type prefix.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall typed_tx: signing_hash_{type}(tx) includes type_prefix_byte; different types => different hash domains

properties_with_code.text: EIP-7702 SetCodeTransaction authorizations must be bound to signature via signing_hash_7702.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall SetCodeTx: signing_hash_7702(tx) commits to tx.authorizations field

properties_with_code.text: EIP-4844 blob_versioned_hashes and max_fee_per_blob_gas must be bound to signature.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall BlobTx: signing_hash_4844(tx) commits to tx.blob_versioned_hashes AND tx.max_fee_per_blob_gas

properties_with_code.text: Calldata floor cost must use tokenization: zero_bytes=1 token, non-zero=4 tokens, at FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST per token.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall calc_intrinsic(tx): tokens = zero_bytes*1 + nonzero_bytes*4; floor = tokens*FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST + TX_BASE_COST

properties_with_code.text: SetCodeTransaction must add PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST per authorization to intrinsic cost.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall SetCodeTx: intrinsic_cost includes PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST * len(tx.authorizations)

properties_with_code.text: Typed transaction signing hashes must include chain_id for cross-chain replay protection.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall typed_signing_hash(tx): chain_id is first field in RLP encoding

properties_with_code.text: Legacy transaction v values outside {27,28} and valid EIP-155 range must be rejected.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover_sender(legacy_tx): v not in {27,28} AND not eip155_encoded(v) => raise InvalidSignatureError

properties_with_code.text: Typed transaction y_parity must be exactly 0 or 1; other values must be rejected.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall recover_sender(typed_tx): tx.y_parity not in {0, 1} => raise InvalidSignatureError

locations.note: Validates v in {0,1} for typed transactions

properties_with_code.text: RLP decoding of malformed transaction bytes must not cause unbounded resource consumption.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall decode_tx(bytes): rlp.decode_to(type, bytes) completes in O(len(bytes)) time and memory

properties_with_code.text: Transaction declared data length field must match actual payload byte length before processing.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall tx: tx.declared_length == len(tx.payload) || reject(tx)

locations.note: RLP validates declared vs actual lengths

properties_with_code.text: Cached state root must be used for critical lookups; recomputation must not silently override it.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall state, key: cached_root != None => lookup(key) uses cached_root, not recompute_root(state)

properties_with_code.text: Nested snapshot rollback must restore parent snapshot values, not grandparent or current tier.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall snap_stack: rollback(snap_stack[-1]) restores state == snap_stack[-1].saved_state

properties_with_code.text: GAS_CAP constant must equal 16777216 (2^24) at all enforcement points.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall enforcement_point ep: ep.GAS_CAP == 16777216

properties_with_code.text: No transaction with gasLimit > 16777216 may enter the txpool.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall tx in txpool: tx.gasLimit <= 16777216

properties_with_code.text: Every transaction in a valid block must have gasLimit <= 16777216.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall block B accepted: forall tx in B.transactions: tx.gasLimit <= 16777216

locations.note: Block validation checks each tx gas limit

properties_with_code.text: Block validation must iterate ALL transactions before acceptance.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall block B accepted: all(checked(tx) for tx in B.transactions)

locations.note: Iterates and validates all transactions in block

properties_with_code.text: A single transaction with gasLimit > 16777216 invalidates the entire block.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall block B: exists tx in B where tx.gasLimit > 16777216 => reject(B)

locations.note: Returns error on first invalid tx, block rejected

properties_with_code.text: Gas cap enforced at both txpool and block validation layers.
properties_with_code.assertion: gas_cap_check(txpool_layer) AND gas_cap_check(block_validation_layer)

properties_with_code.text: Gas cap constant 16777216 is consistent across txpool and block validation.
properties_with_code.assertion: txpool.GAS_CAP == block_validator.GAS_CAP == 16777216

locations.note: Single constant used by both layers

properties_with_code.text: Transaction rejected at txpool level must never reach block validation.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall tx: txpool_reject(tx) => not_in_any_block(tx)

properties_with_code.text: Gas cap applies regardless of block gas limit set by validators.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall tx, B: tx.gasLimit > 16777216 => reject(tx) regardless of B.gasLimit

locations.note: Check is independent of block gas limit

properties_with_code.text: ModExp multiplication_complexity >= 16 for all inputs.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall (base_len, mod_len): calc_mult_complexity(base_len, mod_len) >= 16

locations.note: ModExp precompile gas calculation with complexity floor

properties_with_code.text: ModExp complexity for large inputs equals 2 * ceil(max_length/8)^2.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall (b, m): max(b,m) > 32 => complexity == 2 * ceil(max(b,m)/8)**2
